subject.title: [Bug] Telegram inbound images download but are not passed to model as vision input

question: Should current-turn image resolution forward source-aligned partial native images when some same-turn attachments fail, or keep the current all-or-nothing fallback until a richer media contract exists?
rationale: Current main has an explicit fallback test, while the open closing PR changes shared channel/media delivery semantics and prior review found that the intended partial-media contract needs maintainer choice.

options.title: Repair aligned partial delivery
options.body: Allow partial native forwarding only after failed attachment positions remain source-aligned through the downstream prompt-image boundary and real transport proof is supplied.

options.title: Keep fallback behavior
options.body: Preserve the current all-or-nothing fallback and close or narrow the linked PR if partial native delivery is not the desired contract.

options.title: Replace with broader media contract
options.body: Pause the linked PR and design a broader shared media-delivery contract before changing partial image behavior.

recommendation.title: Repair aligned partial delivery
recommendation.body: Allow partial native forwarding only after failed attachment positions remain source-aligned through the downstream prompt-image boundary and real transport proof is supplied.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc is the current-line owner and authored recent mixed image-order work in the same resolver.
